If you have the VIP card with daily free games, those only start getting used once the standard 'free games' are finished, and of course at most one is used a day. There seems to be a limit of 365 free daily games. / Wednesdays are 50% off on normal prices, with VIP's 'discount' stacking. e.g. Pump It Up goes from 4 credits non-VIP to 2 credits, with the VIP price going from 3.5 to 1.5 credits. / Open every day, including public holidays.
